title: Rate Lock Commitment Delivery at Funding and Settlement of Lock Costs at Closing
content:
**Closing desk rule.** A Rate Lock Commitment is delivered when its loan funds on or before the lock expiration date. Funding after expiration requires a relock first.

At closing, each booked lock cost borne by the borrower and not waived is collected as a price adjustment on the Closing Disclosure. There is one settlement entry per pricing entry, for the same amount. This applies where the product collects extension costs at closing. A lock that never closes never collects them.

| Pricing entry on the lock | At closing |
|---|---|
| Borrower-borne cost, not waived | Collected: one settlement entry for the same amount |
| Cost borne by Larkspur | Nothing to collect |
| Waived cost | Not collected |
| Any cost, where the lock never closes | Never collected |

*Hypothetical illustration:* a lock carries 2 borrower-borne extension entries of $250.00 and $400.00, and the second has been waived. At closing, one settlement entry of $250.00 is collected for the first entry. Nothing is collected for the waived second entry.
